note: Bibcite core renders CSL bibliographic data to citations and defines two plugin types (bibcite_processor - citation renderers, shipped 'citeproc-php'; bibcite_format - YAML import/export formats). Its writable state is the config object bibcite.settings (processor, default_style, convert_urls) and bibcite_csl_style config entities (the CSL styles). Medium/hard cases are grounded in those: setting/reading bibcite.settings and creating/reading a bibcite_csl_style config entity (both router-safe on this site). NOTE: on this shared site the module's shipped default config did not install (bibcite.settings was null, no CSL styles present) and serialization/route-rebuilds fatal, so cases assert on the config object value / config entity presence rather than on rendered citations; cleanup restores the intended shipped defaults (processor=citeproc-php, default_style=apa).

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site using the bibcite (Bibliography & Citation) module, how do I change the default citation style used to render references, and which config object/keys control the citation processor and default style?
evals.expected_output: Edit the config object bibcite.settings: default_style is the id of the default bibcite_csl_style (e.g. apa, chicago_author_date) and processor is the bibcite_processor plugin id (default citeproc-php). Set at /admin/config/bibcite or via drush cset bibcite.settings default_style <id>.

evals.prompt: Which plugin types does the bibcite core module define, and what is each used for?
evals.expected_output: Two: bibcite_processor (attribute/annotation plugins that render CSL data into a citation string - the shipped one is citeproc-php) and bibcite_format (YAML-declared import/export formats whose encoder class implements Symfony Encoder/Decoder - provided by the bibtex/endnote/marc/ris submodules).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which citation style is configured as the site-wide default in the bibcite settings? Inspect the live configuration to answer.
evals.expected_output: The default style is Chicago author-date: bibcite.settings:default_style is 'chicago_author_date'.

evals.prompt: This site has a custom CSL citation style installed via bibcite. Inspect the bibcite_csl_style configuration entities and give the machine id of the custom style.
evals.expected_output: The custom style is bibcite_known_style (label 'Bibcite Known Style'), a bibcite_csl_style config entity with custom = true.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure bibcite so that the default citation style is APA and citations linkify URLs (convert URLs on). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set bibcite.settings:default_style to 'apa' and bibcite.settings:convert_urls to true (e.g. drush cset bibcite.settings default_style apa; drush cset bibcite.settings convert_urls 1, or via configFactory).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, register a new CSL citation style in bibcite with machine id 'bibcite_harvard' and label 'Harvard'. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a bibcite_csl_style config entity: Drupal\bibcite\Entity\CslStyle::create(['id' => 'bibcite_harvard', 'label' => 'Harvard', 'csl' => '<CSL XML>', 'custom' => TRUE])->save(); (or add it via the CSL styles collection UI at /admin/config/bibcite/settings/csl_style).
